mapper.select: SELECT order_id FROM t_checkout_session WHERE public_token=#{token}

SELECT o.version AS order_version,s.version AS session_version,c.version AS consumer_version FROM t_checkout_session s JOIN t_commerce_order o ON o.order_id=s.order_id LEFT JOIN t_consumer_context c ON c.order_id=o.order_id WHERE s.public_token=#{token} AND s.order_id=#{orderId} AND s.checkout_session_id=#{sessionId}
